name: kmp
description: Kotlin Multiplatform on top of the kotlin-android pack: keeps platform APIs out of commonMain, requires explicit public API, and turns warnings into errors on every target.

merge.into: each multiplatform module's build.gradle.kts (or a convention plugin)
merge.how: Enable explicitApi() and allWarningsAsErrors, and layer detekt-kmp.yml over detekt.yml with every source set listed so detekt sees commonMain.

baseline: Same as the kotlin-android pack: ./gradlew detektBaseline, committed.
